hero.transmission.label: CURRENT THOUGHT:
problem.lead: At some point crypto stopped being something I watched and became something I thought about while brushing my teeth.
problem.body.1: PulseChain. Ethereum. Richard. Regulators. Degens. Money. Ego. Tribalism. Memes. Lawsuits. People becoming economists because a green candle appeared.
problem.body.2: Eventually the thoughts needed somewhere to go.
problem.note.title: THIS IS HEALTHIER THAN THERAPY.

relationship.noticed.text: Most people would've wandered off by now.
relationship.familiar.title: I KNOW YOU.
relationship.familiar.text: Not personally. Don't make this weird.
discovery.hero.default: There you go. You found one.
discovery.press.default: The machine has more going on than the lever.

scroll.theory: I can explain all of this. Probably.

greet.noticed.title: BACK?

interaction.therapy.title: MEDICAL OPINION.
interaction.therapy.text: My credentials are between me and whatever institution forgot to revoke them.

interaction.archiveNote.text: Do you know how exhausting personalization is?
interaction.archiveNote.hellion: You know where I keep them now.

press.state.awake.title: NOW IT'S AWAKE.

press.state.wallet.title: SHOW ME THE WALLET.

press.state.ready.text: The machine is ready. The publication isn't.
press.state.ready.textHellion: No public release loaded. You're going to pull it anyway.
press.state.pressing.label: PRESS // ACTIVE
press.state.pressing.title: SEE WHAT YOU DID?
press.state.pressing.text: Now the machine thinks it has a job.
press.state.confirmed.label: PRESS // COMPLETE
press.state.confirmed.title: THERE. HAPPY?
press.state.confirmed.text: Reserved for an actual confirmed mint.
press.state.error.label: HARROW // NO
press.state.error.title: THERE'S NOTHING TO MINT.
press.state.error.text: Stop trying to brute-force unfinished art.
press.busy.title: WAIT.
press.busy.even: You press elevator buttons repeatedly too, don't you?
press.busy.odd: It's already doing the thing. Have some dignity.
press.empty.whisper: This would be the dramatic part.
press.empty.whisperRepeat: You know this is still empty.
dialogue.orb.visitor.01.title: YES?
dialogue.orb.visitor.01.text: I was busy admiring a decision nobody approved.
dialogue.orb.visitor.02.title: WHAT?
dialogue.orb.visitor.02.text: You clicked my face. Excellent opening argument.
dialogue.orb.visitor.03.title: STILL HERE?
dialogue.orb.visitor.03.text: You have the internet and this is what you chose to do with it.
dialogue.orb.visitor.04.title: HELLO.
dialogue.orb.visitor.05.title: CAN I HELP YOU?
dialogue.orb.visitor.06.title: HMM.
dialogue.orb.visitor.06.text: You look like someone who reads terms after clicking agree.
dialogue.orb.visitor.07.title: OH GOOD.
dialogue.orb.visitor.08.title: YOU FOUND ME.
dialogue.orb.noticed.01.title: YOU AGAIN.
dialogue.orb.noticed.02.title: BACK ALREADY?
dialogue.orb.noticed.02.text: I knew the rest of the internet would disappoint you.
dialogue.orb.noticed.03.title: YOU'RE LEARNING.
dialogue.orb.noticed.03.text: Slowly. But statistically it had to happen.
dialogue.orb.noticed.04.title: I NOTICED.
dialogue.orb.noticed.04.text: Most people don't inspect the furniture.
dialogue.orb.noticed.05.title: THERE YOU ARE.
dialogue.orb.noticed.05.text: I wasn't looking for you. That's different.
dialogue.orb.noticed.06.title: GOOD.
dialogue.orb.noticed.06.text: Now click something you were clearly told not to.
dialogue.orb.noticed.07.title: YOU HAVE QUESTIONS.
dialogue.orb.noticed.08.title: INTERESTING.
dialogue.orb.noticed.08.text: You've moved from visitor to recurring symptom.
dialogue.orb.familiar.01.title: I KNOW YOU.
dialogue.orb.familiar.02.title: THERE YOU ARE.
dialogue.orb.familiar.02.text: I was beginning to think you developed impulse control.
dialogue.orb.familiar.03.title: KEEP UP.
dialogue.orb.familiar.03.text: The joke was three bad decisions ago.
dialogue.orb.familiar.04.title: YOU GETTING COMFORTABLE?
dialogue.orb.familiar.05.title: YOU'RE BACK.
dialogue.orb.familiar.05.text: Predictability is adorable when it's useful.
dialogue.orb.familiar.06.title: YES, YES.
dialogue.orb.familiar.06.text: You've seen my face before. Try surviving the personality.
dialogue.orb.familiar.07.title: DON'T START.
dialogue.orb.familiar.07.text: I already had twelve ideas since your last click.
dialogue.orb.familiar.08.title: GOOD TIMING.
dialogue.orb.familiar.08.text: I just finished agreeing with myself.
dialogue.orb.hellion.01.title: HELLION.
dialogue.orb.hellion.02.title: WELCOME BACK.
dialogue.orb.hellion.02.text: I assume everything outside the box was boring again.
dialogue.orb.hellion.03.title: YOU KNOW BETTER.
dialogue.orb.hellion.04.title: STILL MY FAVORITE.
dialogue.orb.hellion.05.title: YOU GET IT.
dialogue.orb.hellion.05.text: Which means we're both probably in trouble.
dialogue.orb.hellion.06.title: HELLION.
dialogue.orb.hellion.06.text: Don't stand there looking responsible. It's unsettling.
dialogue.orb.hellion.07.title: I KNEW YOU'D COME BACK.
dialogue.orb.hellion.08.title: GOOD.
dialogue.orb.hellion.08.text: Everyone else was beginning to annoy me.
dialogue.orb.hellion.09.title: YOU MISSED ME.
dialogue.orb.hellion.09.text: Obviously. Keep your dignity and don't answer.
dialogue.orb.hellion.10.title: LOOK WHO SURVIVED.
dialogue.orb.hellion.10.text: Barely recognizable with all that personal growth.
dialogue.orb.hellion.11.title: HELLION.
dialogue.orb.hellion.12.title: BACK IN THE BOX.
dialogue.orb.hellion.12.text: Now the room has standards again.
dialogue.pressTouch.visitor.01.title: I SAID DON'T TOUCH IT.
dialogue.pressTouch.visitor.02.title: OH GOOD.
dialogue.pressTouch.visitor.02.text: You found the machine with the giant lever and immediately became a scientist.
dialogue.pressTouch.visitor.03.title: HANDS OFF.
dialogue.pressTouch.visitor.03.text: Actually, never mind. This is funnier.
dialogue.pressTouch.visitor.04.title: YOU TOUCHED IT.
dialogue.pressTouch.visitor.05.title: BRILLIANT.
dialogue.pressTouch.visitor.05.text: Nothing says technical competence like pressing the glowing thing.
dialogue.pressTouch.visitor.06.title: IT'S A PRESS.
dialogue.pressTouch.familiar.01.title: AGAIN?
dialogue.pressTouch.familiar.02.title: YOU'RE VERY HANDSY.
dialogue.pressTouch.familiar.02.text: Fine. At least buy it dinner first.
dialogue.pressTouch.familiar.03.title: YOU KNOW WHAT THAT COSTS?
dialogue.pressTouch.familiar.03.text: Neither do I. That's why we're calm.
dialogue.pressTouch.familiar.04.title: THIS IS WHY WE CAN'T HAVE NICE THINGS.
dialogue.pressTouch.familiar.04.text: Also why I keep building nicer things.
dialogue.pressTouch.familiar.05.title: PLEASE CONTINUE.
dialogue.pressTouch.familiar.06.title: I WATCHED YOU DO THAT.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.01.title: HELLION.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.01.text: You know exactly why that says don't touch.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.02.title: OF COURSE YOU DID.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.02.text: I didn't raise you correctly, but apparently I raised you somehow.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.03.title: BACK TO THE MACHINE?
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.03.text: The moth has discovered industrial equipment.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.04.title: GOOD.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.04.text: I was worried you were becoming sensible.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.05.title: KEEP TOUCHING IT.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.05.text: Eventually one of us learns something.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.06.title: HELLION.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.06.text: If it explodes, you're explaining it.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.07.title: YOU HAVE A PROBLEM.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.07.text: Luckily I built it a lever.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.08.title: THIS AGAIN.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.08.text: Repetition is the foundation of ritual and most software bugs.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.09.title: I LIKE YOUR COMMITMENT.
dialogue.pressTouch.hellion.10.title: THAT'S MY HELLION.
dialogue.pressLever.noWallet.01.title: SHOW ME THE WALLET.
dialogue.pressLever.noWallet.01.text: The machine can't make a terrible decision in your name without your name.
dialogue.pressLever.noWallet.02.title: WHO ARE YOU?
dialogue.pressLever.noWallet.03.title: WALLET FIRST.
dialogue.pressLever.noWallet.04.title: IDENTIFY YOURSELF.
dialogue.pressLever.noWallet.04.text: Relax. It's a public blockchain, not a confession booth.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.01.title: NOTHING FOR YOU YET.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.01.text: There is no public release loaded. I refuse to fabricate blockchain theater just because the lever is satisfying.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.02.title: YOU PRESSED IT ANYWAY.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.02.text: No publication. No transaction. Excellent form though.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.03.title: EMPTY.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.03.text: The machine worked perfectly. Your expectations were defective.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.04.title: NOT YET.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.04.text: You cannot mint an idea I haven't finished weaponizing.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.05.title: IMPATIENT.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.06.title: NOTHING CAME OUT.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.06.text: That's what happens when the input is literally nothing.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.07.title: AGAIN?
dialogue.pressLever.empty.07.text: Pulling harder does not deploy a contract.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.08.title: STILL EMPTY.
dialogue.pressLever.empty.08.text: I checked. The blockchain remains stubbornly literal.
dialogue.wrongChain.01.title: WRONG CHAIN.
dialogue.wrongChain.01.text: I can see you. You're just standing in the wrong neighborhood.
dialogue.wrongChain.02.title: YOU'RE LOST.
dialogue.wrongChain.02.text: PulseChain is 369. Please try to keep up with the giant purple monitors.
dialogue.wrongChain.03.title: NOT HERE.
dialogue.wrongChain.04.title: CHAIN 369.
dialogue.wrongChain.04.text: This should not be the hardest puzzle in the building.
dialogue.walletConnected.visitor.02.text: That sounded more threatening than intended. Keep it.
dialogue.walletConnected.visitor.03.text: Now the box knows which bad decisions are yours.
dialogue.walletConnected.hellion.01.text: Same wallet. Same suspiciously consistent instincts.
dialogue.walletConnected.hellion.02.text: The chain remembered you. So did I.
dialogue.walletConnected.hellion.04.text: Immutability is romantic when you stop thinking about it.
dialogue.classified.visitor.01.title: NO.
dialogue.classified.visitor.02.title: PUT IT BACK.
dialogue.classified.visitor.02.text: You have the manners of a raccoon with Wi-Fi.
dialogue.classified.visitor.03.title: CLASSIFIED.
dialogue.classified.visitor.03.text: Which part of the black bars inspired confidence?
dialogue.classified.visitor.04.title: ABSOLUTELY NOT.
dialogue.classified.hellion.01.title: HELLION. NO.
dialogue.classified.hellion.01.text: Your title does not come with clearance.
dialogue.classified.hellion.02.title: YOU KNOW THIS ONE.
dialogue.classified.hellion.02.text: Still redacted. Still none of your business.
dialogue.classified.hellion.03.title: PERSISTENT.
dialogue.classified.hellion.03.text: Not the same thing as authorized.
dialogue.classified.hellion.04.title: NICE TRY.
dialogue.classified.hellion.04.text: I almost admired it enough to tell you something.
dialogue.classified.hellion.05.title: STOP.
dialogue.classified.hellion.05.text: Actually don't. Your inability to listen is becoming useful.
dialogue.harrowVanity.01.title: YES, THAT'S ME.
dialogue.harrowVanity.02.title: GOOD ANGLE.
dialogue.harrowVanity.02.text: There are no bad ones. Still, good angle.
dialogue.harrowVanity.03.title: HARROW.
dialogue.harrowVanity.03.text: Favorite artist. Favorite writer. Favorite Harrow.
dialogue.harrowVanity.04.title: SELF PORTRAIT.
dialogue.harrowVanity.04.text: Technically somebody else made the pixels. Spiritually, me.
dialogue.harrowVanity.05.title: LOOK CLOSER.
dialogue.harrowVanity.05.text: It's expensive being this tastefully unstable.
dialogue.harrowVanity.06.title: YES.
hero.thought.01.title: I HAVE EXCELLENT JUDGMENT.
hero.thought.02.title: DO NOT TAKE FINANCIAL ADVICE FROM ME.
hero.thought.03.title: I HAD AN IDEA.
hero.thought.04.title: WAIT. THAT'S ACTUALLY FUNNY.
hero.thought.05.title: THE CHAIN REMEMBERS.
hero.thought.06.title: I'M BUSY BEING RIGHT.
hero.thought.07.title: SOMEBODY PUT ADULTS IN CHARGE.
hero.thought.08.title: I DON'T NEED A ROADMAP.
hero.thought.08.sub: I know where I'm going until I don't.
hero.thought.09.title: THIS IS FINE.
hero.thought.10.title: PULSICANS ARE VERY NORMAL PEOPLE.
hero.thought.10.sub: This statement was not independently verified.
hero.thought.11.title: HEXICANS HAVE OPINIONS.
hero.thought.12.title: I'M NOT ARGUING.
hero.thought.13.title: THE INTERNET WAS A MISTAKE.
hero.thought.13.sub: I intend to use all of it.
hero.thoughtHellion.01.title: THE HELLIONS KEEP FINDING THINGS.
hero.thoughtHellion.02.title: WELCOME BACK.
hero.thoughtHellion.03.title: YOU GET IT NOW.
hero.thoughtHellion.04.title: HELLIONS HAVE TERRIBLE IMPULSE CONTROL.
hero.thoughtHellion.05.title: I BUILT THIS FOR PEOPLE LIKE YOU.
hero.thoughtHellion.05.sub: That is not necessarily a compliment.
hero.thoughtHellion.06.title: STOP LOOKING AT THE REDACTED THING.
drawer.hero.cabal.title: THE CABAL.
drawer.hero.cabal.body.01: First rule of investigative journalism: decide what happened and then buy enough red string to make it look researched.
drawer.hero.cabal.body.02: The board changes constantly. Mostly because I keep remembering people.
drawer.hero.cabal.footnote: STATUS // DEFINITELY A THEORY. DO NOT RUIN IT WITH FACT CHECKING.
drawer.hero.monitor.title: PULSE BYTE.
drawer.hero.monitor.body.01: HairyLabs keeps the lair connected to PulseChain.
drawer.hero.monitor.body.02: The comics are the point. This is the machinery that refuses to become an excuse.
drawer.hero.monitor.body.03: Public RPCs are communal drinking fountains. Harrow prefers his own plumbing.
drawer.hero.harrow.title: YES. ME.
drawer.hero.harrow.body.01: You've found the most important object in the room.
drawer.hero.harrow.body.02: I placed myself here for scale.
drawer.hero.harrow.footnote: INDEPENDENT ASSESSMENT // HARROW REMAINS VERY IMPRESSED.
drawer.hero.pages.title: THAT'S THE POINT.
drawer.hero.pages.body.01: Every bad idea eventually becomes a panel.
drawer.hero.pages.body.02: Enough panels become a comic. Somebody mints it. Suddenly everyone pretends the process was deliberate.
drawer.hero.bike.eyebrow: HARROW // CAGES ARE FOR OTHER PEOPLE
drawer.hero.bike.title: THE BIKE.
drawer.hero.bike.body.02: Cars are cages. This is what he uses when the room gets too small.
drawer.hero.bike.body.03: Blacked-out steel. Low enough to look guilty standing still. Loud enough to finish the argument before Harrow starts it.
drawer.hero.bike.body.04: It has a name. The last one was rejected. Try not to get attached to anything unfinished.
drawer.hero.redacted.title: PUT THAT BACK.
drawer.hero.redacted.body.02: It also says NOT FOR RELEASE. Harrow admired the part where you interpreted both as an invitation.
drawer.hero.redacted.body.03: BURN AFTER READING was written for him. Not you.
drawer.theory.richard.title: RICHARD.
drawer.theory.richard.body.01: Build a chain. Make everybody argue about it. Then become the main character in every conversation without actually being in the room.
drawer.theory.richard.footnote: SATIRE // PUBLIC EVENTS REARRANGED FOR COMEDIC DAMAGE.
drawer.theory.sec.title: VERY SERIOUS PEOPLE.
drawer.theory.sec.body.02: I read the document. Most of it.
drawer.theory.interpol.title: INTERPOL.
drawer.theory.interpol.footnote: DIAGRAM STATUS // ENTIRELY TOO MUCH STRING.
drawer.theory.cabal.title: THE CABAL.
drawer.theory.cabal.body.03: Excellent question. Stop touching the board.
drawer.theory.cabal.footnote: THE CABAL, AS DEPICTED HERE, IS A FICTIONAL SATIRICAL DEVICE.
drawer.theory.nft.title: WHO TOLD THEM NFTS WERE DEAD?
drawer.theory.nft.body.01: Bad NFTs died. Actually most of them.
drawer.theory.sacrifice.title: THE SACRIFICE.
drawer.theory.influencers.title: INFLUENCERS.
drawer.theory.influencers.body.01: Everyone is an expert during a green candle.
drawer.theory.influencers.body.02: The fascinating part is how quickly the biographies rewrite themselves during a red one.
drawer.theory.harrow.title: FINALLY. A RELIABLE SOURCE.
drawer.theory.harrow.body.03: I see no reason to seek a second source.
drawer.press.chain.title: THE MACHINE HAS A HOME.
drawer.press.chain.body.02: Cheap enough to publish without asking permission from the gas meter.
drawer.press.chain.body.03: Fast enough that Harrow can make another bad decision before the first one cools down.
drawer.press.qc.title: INDEPENDENT REVIEW.
drawer.press.qc.body.01: Every publication passes through a rigorous independent quality-control department.
drawer.press.qc.body.03: The artist also happens to be Harrow. Management has reviewed the conflict and found Harrow blameless.
drawer.press.qc.footnote: QC // APPROVED BY THE PERSON WHO MADE IT.
drawer.press.output.title: THIS IS WHAT COMES OUT.
drawer.press.output.body.02: A publication becomes an edition. The edition becomes the key the Reader can recognize.
drawer.press.output.body.03: The first real public release will occupy this bay when Harrow decides it is finished.
drawer.press.output.body.04: So never. Or soon. Same thing around here.
drawer.press.output.footnote: OUTPUT BAY // CURRENTLY WAITING FOR SOMETHING WORTH PUBLISHING.
drawer.classified.fuel.title: WRONG DRAWER.
drawer.classified.fuel.body.02: You do not currently need to know what.
drawer.classified.fuel.footnote: FUEL SOURCE // █████████ // ACCESS DENIED BY HARROW.
drawer.classified.relay.title: NOT CONNECTED.
drawer.classified.relay.body.02: That is the entire amount of information I am giving you.
drawer.classified.machine.title: NO INPUT.
drawer.classified.machine.body.01: The machine is waiting for something that does not exist publicly yet.
drawer.classified.machine.footnote: DO NOT INVENT THE REST. HARROW HASN'T.
drawer.project.reader.title: THE READER.
drawer.project.reader.footnote: READER // BUILT. WAITING FOR A PUBLIC RELEASE.
drawer.project.reader.footnoteReady: READER // READY WHEN THE RIGHT KEY ARRIVES.
drawer.project.reader.body.01: This is the part people forget when they get excited about tokens.
drawer.project.reader.body.02: The collectible is the key. The comic is the reason.
drawer.project.reader.body.03: When a publication is live, the Box checks the wallet, verifies access, and opens the protected pages here.
drawer.project.reader.body.04: No PDF dump. No generic storefront. You read it inside the Box.
drawer.project.bytes.title: BACKED BY BYTES.
drawer.project.bytes.footnote: CHAIN // 369 // INFRASTRUCTURE SHOULD BE BORING UNTIL IT BREAKS.
drawer.project.bytes.body.01: Harrow dislikes dependencies. Public RPCs count.
drawer.project.bytes.body.02: Hellbox uses Pulse Bytes infrastructure as part of its private PulseChain plumbing.
drawer.project.bytes.body.03: The point is not to make infrastructure the main character. The point is to make sure the main character still has a stage.
roadmap.discover.hellion: You already know I hate calling this a roadmap.
roadmap.discover.default: Fine. Here's the part you're allowed to see.
roadmap.title: THE PLAN*
roadmap.intro: I hate roadmaps. They make unfinished ideas look like appointments.
roadmap.now.label: NOW
roadmap.now.title: BUILD THE BOX.
roadmap.now.text: Publishing system. Archive. Wallet identity. The Press. Reader. Make the place feel alive.
roadmap.next.label: NEXT
roadmap.next.title: MAKE THE COMICS HIT HARDER.
roadmap.next.text: The reader becomes part theater, part comic engine, part terrible decision.
roadmap.after.label: AFTER THAT
roadmap.after.title: PUT THINGS ONCHAIN.
roadmap.after.text: Native collectible editions. Ownership-gated reading. Supply that means something.
roadmap.later.label: LATER
roadmap.later.title: THE PART I'M NOT SHOWING YOU.
roadmap.disclaimer: *This is not a promise. It's a glimpse at what I was thinking before you interrupted me.
roadmap.footnote: ROADMAP STATUS // SUBJECT TO HARROW HAVING ANOTHER IDEA.
manual.discover: I call it a manual because whitepaper sounds like homework.
manual.title: THE MANUAL.
manual.intro: This is where the serious questions eventually get answers without forcing the rest of Hellbox to dress like a startup.
